quick_english: By the individual means and its rule, this is determined for those who desire the supreme abode.
When conceptualization is purified and the desired thing is unopposed, attainment of enjoyment and liberation is certain.
Conceptualization becomes very stable when it arises from one's own self-freedom, without dependence on other means.
For someone, conceptualization directed toward self-purification is said to depend on other means, according to the previous rule.
Conceptualization is called the nature of pure consciousness; though situated, it still joins freedom for the limited self.
Certainty is manifold, and the means there are distinct; they are spoken of by the word anu according to far and near.
Ultimate truth shines in intellect, breath, body, and cognizer, even in what is non-ultimate.
Because it is non-different from pure consciousness light, that body of inert and conscious is doubled through freedom.
In Traishirasa it is said to the goddess: the individual soul is Shiva's power, situated everywhere.
Established in realization of one's own nature, supreme through unfolding knowledge, consciousness-nature is true through conception of freedom's expansion.
There, hiding duality by seeing the inert-self portion, one may become non-dual by the view of freedom, like a face in a mirror.
Pure own consciousness is determined as that nature, distinct from intellect, breath, and the rest, by force.
From purity alone arises the non-difference of world-form with truth, since mutual difference would divide it.
Even if forms conflict, all being remains within consciousness rather than resting otherwise in intellect.
Even so, in this doubt-free state there is no doubt without that support.
But certainty in intellect, breath, and body comes directly through supreme lordship.
What is imagined has void-form, but imagining does not occur in the knower; there intellect is meditation and breath is utterance.
Utterance includes five breath functions from prana to vyana, and the first would be supreme utterance-natured.
The body is established as a mass of sense objects; there the meditation-made supreme is spoken here.
The independent consciousness-natured light situated in the heart is all-principle-made, as said in the trishira doctrine.
The principle-knower sees within the heart a banana-sheath-shaped form with outer, inner, and middle, like a flower.
There one should meditate with unwavering mind on the conjunction of moon, sun, and fire; that meditation agitation makes great Bhairava consume offerings.
Blazing in the great heart-basin, fullness would arise for that power-possessor with expanded power and Bhairava radiance.
One should contemplate knower, knowing, and known by abode non-difference; the fire, sun, and moon powers become that same triad.

quick_english: The supreme, supreme-and-lower, and lower goddesses are always arisen; through creation, preservation, and dissolution they are individually threefold.
The fourth unlimited form of them is unimagined; thus twelve goddesses are situated like sun discs.
Of each of them, fire, sun, moon, and their peace-radiance is this supreme wheel, from heart and eyes and so on.

quick_english: It goes indeed through voids in each object domain; by that wheel radiance there in meaning, by creation, preservation, and dissolution order.
The moon-sun-fire radiance-nature form stands together; thus in sound and other objects, by the ear and other void paths.

tokens.grounds: third singular present verb plus pronoun

quick_english: By this falling wheel one should contemplate identity; by this ordered union, wherever that falls.

tokens.grounds: third singular passive or middle present verb

quick_english: The all-natured wheel, like each all-earthly king, thus dissolves the world path layer effortlessly.
In the Bhairava great wheel surrounded by consciousness, then by impression only, even the world is destroyed.
By own self rising, one should meditate the great revolving wheel; then by that burnable dissolution and that impression destruction.

tokens.grounds: third singular optative active compound verb
third singular passive or middle present verb

quick_english: One should contemplate the calming wheel; then peaceful, then peace; by this meditation union the world dissolves in the wheel.
In that consciousness, then consciousness-dissolved meaning alone shines; by consciousness nature, then again creation, which is conscious great lady.
Thus every moment, dissolving and emitting the world in own consciousness, then again one should go to perpetual Bhairava state.
Thus, from trishula onward, by the four-five-ara sequence up to fifty ara, the yogi should visualize the wheel.
Or the sixty-four-hundred-ara wheel, or the thousand-ara wheel, or the countless-thousand-ara wheel, the one of undivided mind should meditate.
Of the great lord of consciousness, of the god of arising consciousness, there is no calculation at all of the great lord of world-power.
His powers are the whole world; the power-holder is the great lord. Thus, in the auspicious scripture, Sri Srikantha explained.
Thus this first-means-form meditation was explained by Sri Shambhunatha; to me, Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased to him.
By this same direction, other meditations too should be resorted to, those that reach the burden of the unexcelled means without sequence.
Now, breath's function, beginning with prana, is explained; by that means we speak of unexcelled expansion.
Situated formerly in the heart in own bliss, in the measure of knower and object, from rest in mere void, one should visualize the blissless.
At breath rising, in the object, one should visualize supreme bliss; there, freed by filling endless object parts with apana.
Standing in supreme bliss, adorned by the apana moon, then one is freed by the single contact of endless shining objects.
Having reached the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss; then also one is intent on swallowing the mass of knower-known calculation.
Resting in udana fire, one should visualize great bliss; there, having reached rest, one becomes calm in that great flame.

quick_english: Then indeed consciousness-bliss, not strengthened by the insentient, is the great pervasion free from support.

From mutual friction of moon and sun phase nets, in the fire-moon abode, emission bliss opens.

quick_english: With the mouth within, rightly bloom consciousness forth; the lofty imperishable wheel of consciousness, non-different from the knowable, becomes thence.

In inner and outer both, beautiful beyond common and uncommon, the self of consciousness-throb and three powers holds contraction and expansion.

quick_english: Radiant with doubled six wheels, standing there one should examine void, void, standing in void; by the void-dweller one should enter.

The roots of the self-atom family are power, being, consciousness, delight; the three powers, tinged by seer and seen, are free from that.

By difference, subdifference, and difference, the difference is to be done from the middle; thus the entry means is proclaimed.
The glorious ten-formed rava, spoken by me and also said in the holy Brahmayamala, is seated in the heart by Lord Maheshvara.

Knowing, one reels; reeling is great pervasion, remembered; in self nonself conception, indeed true in nonself.
